facts.text: Stony Brook co-manages Brookhaven National Laboratory for the U.S. Department of Energy, one of only eight universities nationwide with a role in running a federal research laboratory.

facts.text: Under the Stony Brook Curriculum general education program, all undergraduates must demonstrate versatility across 10 foundational learning categories and complete advanced studies in three of four distinct areas.
